dependency_addition_reviews.name: httpx
dependency_addition_reviews.provenance: Installed distribution metadata and FastAPI TestClient runtime requirements.
dependency_addition_reviews.rationale: FastAPI TestClient requires HTTPX during test collection and execution.

dependency_addition_reviews.name: websockets
dependency_addition_reviews.provenance: Installed distribution metadata and the project API optional-dependency declaration.
dependency_addition_reviews.rationale: Uvicorn needs a WebSocket implementation to serve the Command Center realtime path advertised by the API.
